Quick infra constraints and recommendation:

- Maintenance: We have a planned kernel upgrade and GPU host patching window on Sep 12 22:00 - Sep 13 06:00 PDT. Expected ~10% transient capacity reduction; we'll aim to drain long-lived jobs.
- Pool status (current): 28 x H100, 42 x A100-80GB available for allocation across regions in our US pool (non-dedicated). Dedicated pools have fragmented availability this quarter.
- Burst slots: We have ~8 flexible burst slots this week and 6 next week (contingent on spot reclaim).

Recommendations:
1) Reserve H100 slots for Nimbus Pilot (DEAL-8471) for day-of-demo peaks (2 x H100 reserved for 3 weeks) — can convert to burst outside peak hours.
2) For Acme Retail POC, recommend A100-80GB quantized model for cost-efficiency; if accuracy checks out, we can trade fidelity for 2x the request capacity.
3) If Nimbus needs additional capacity during maintenance window, route to EU pool (adds latency ~40ms) or fall back to a smaller model variant.

Blockers: Dedicated pool fragmentation — we need confirmed start date to hold slots. Otherwise we can only promise burst-level capacity.
